features.title: The CLI as a Node package only
features.user_visible_behavior: Projects get no copy of the CLI: asdd is installed once per machine (npm i -g, or npm pack from the repo) or as a devDependency; hooks find it and fail closed without it.
verification: cd tools/spec-drift && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
features.evidence: Installer no longer copies .harness/cli (retireProjectCli removes an old copy and legacy .harness/scripts); hooks and the Cursor template run the POSIX resolver (node_modules/.bin/asdd, else asdd on PATH, else exit 2 "asdd is not installed: npm i -D asdd-harness-kit (or npm i -g ...)"); old .harness/cli hooks migrate. main.mjs hands harness commands to node_modules/asdd-harness-kit (signals forwarded) and, without it, checks kit.version (cli/src/pin.mjs: other major refuses, other minor warns on stderr, gate/verify quiet). The installer runs its own asdd for checks (ASDD_DELEGATED). doctor: cli = devDependency | global | none (FAIL), legacy-cli warn. project.json commands: asdd check|verify|drift. CI templates (workflow example, spec-drift generate_ci_gate) install asdd-harness-kit@kit.version. npm package now includes the .github/*.example files the installer copies (an npm install used to fail: missing kit file).
